Class FinishScoreState

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am49.server.model.states.State
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am49.server.model.states.FinishScoreState
public class FinishScoreState extends State
Represents the state of the game when the scoring phase is completed. Only specific actions are permitted in this state, while most user and admin actions will throw an IllegalMethodOnThisStateException. Extends the abstract base class State.
